site.domainNote: web-based database schema / ER diagram designer (dbdesigner.id), start screen with Office-style ribbon

view.name: ERD canvas editor
view.description: Main design workspace with ribbon toolbar and a Konva canvas showing the marketplace schema's tables, columns, types and relation lines.

regions.label: Office-style ribbon tab strip: FILE (blue backstage trigger), HOME, EDIT, ACCOUNT; username + cat avatar at right
HOME ribbon panel with grouped commands: Table (New Table, Save), Export (Export, Share), Page (700 px, 1500 px, 100 %, grid/fit toggles), Feedback
Welcome/start page on grey: Dbdesigner.id title, 'Joy your design' tagline, two-column link lists Recent, Help, New Feature, News

evidence.note: Persistent Office-ribbon frame with tabs, grouped command toolbar and user identity at right
Ribbon tabs; HOME active with white raised tab and blue text; live check: EDIT swaps the ribbon panel (empty in this state)
FILE trigger; live check shows it opens a left backstage panel (New/Open/Properties/Account/Logout + Open project list with search) over a grey scrim

patterns.rationale: Panel is not visible in the capture; only its trigger is. Behavior verified on live copy.

evidence.note: Page group (page width/height, zoom, grid, fit) implies a diagram canvas, but no canvas is shown in the capture

patterns.rationale: Captured state is the start screen ('Data not found' for the uuid); the diagram canvas itself is not rendered.

evidence.note: Start screen shown in place of a diagram: title, recent files, help links (Start design, Introduction Video), news

patterns.rationale: Reads as a welcome/start page rather than a true empty view; no explicit 'nothing here' message.

evidence.note: A 'Data not found' toast appears on live load but is not in the capture
FILE opens a full-height backstage panel, coded as drawer instead of menu

structure.layout: desktop web app: Office-style ribbon (tab strip + grouped icon toolbar) above a grey full-width content area holding a left-aligned start page with two columns of link lists

aesthetics.typography: 'Chinese Quote' (system sans fallback, Helvetica/Arial-like) for ribbon labels (11px), section labels (20px) and links (14px); Segoe UI (falls back to Open Sans-like) for the title h2 30px/400 and tagline h3 24px/300
aesthetics.typeScale: Low contrast hierarchy: 30px regular title, 24px light tagline, 20px section labels, 14px links, 11px ribbon labels, 10px group captions; all weight 400 or lighter

notes: Mimics Microsoft Office ribbon: blue (#0072c6) FILE tab, white active tab, labelled groups (Table/Export/Page/Feedback) with grey caption strip, large 32-40px dark icons with 11px captions, and a red speech-bubble Feedback icon. Username '~ maya.hartono' with orange GitHub-octocat-like avatar at top right. Start page links use antd blue #1890ff; typos ('On Page repot', 'Inroduction Video'). Live: FILE opens Office-style backstage (dark blue left rail + Open list with search and recent projects); a 'Data not found' toast appears on load (not in capture).
